display.purpose: Book title on the book page; 26px on phones.

headline.purpose: Page titles (26px on phones); the 22px/800 sidebar wordmark shares the treatment.

title.purpose: Section titles, player chapter title, import heading, editor paragraph headings.

body.purpose: All running text; editor sentences at 1.65 and source preview at 1.75, capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav items, tabs, form labels, chapter names.

meta.purpose: Durations, scrub times, book metadata, player status; tabular figures. 13px/600 for tags and small print.

shadows.name: player-lift
shadows.purpose: Player cover and floating mini player (light).

shadows.name: player-lift-dark
shadows.purpose: Player cover and floating mini player (dark).

shadows.name: panel-edge
shadows.purpose: Left edge of the desktop player panel.

shadows.name: thumb
shadows.purpose: Scrubber and switch knobs, so they read as draggable.

shadows.name: cover-hairline
shadows.purpose: Printed edge on every generated cover, paired with a 160deg white sheen at 14%.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, colour, opacity and switch transitions on controls.

motion.name: sheet-rise
motion.purpose: Full-screen player sheet rises 24px and fades in.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: player-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Max-width. Player panel becomes a floating mini player plus a full-screen sheet.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Max-width. Sidebar becomes an icon-only top bar; book header stacks; shelf goes to two columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen: accent pill, 44px tall.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 15V4M7 9l5-5 5 5"/><path d="M4 15v3a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-3"/></svg>Vybrať PDF</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 600 15px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #c2410c); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #9a3412); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions: hairline pill, surface fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e7eb); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #111827); font: 600 15px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--surface, #f4f5f7); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Play Button
components.description: Signature control: 64px accent circle with a solid play glyph; presses to 0.95.
components.html: <button class="ds-play" aria-label="Prehrať"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 4.5v15l12.5-7.5z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-play { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #c2410c); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-play:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #9a3412); } .ds-play:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Speed Chips
components.description: 44px pills with tabular figures; the selected chip fills with accent.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e7eb); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #111827); font: 600 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--surface, #f4f5f7); } .ds-chip.ds-on { background: var(--accent, #c2410c); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); border-color: var(--accent, #c2410c); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Raised field with hairline border, 8px radius, accent caret and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 600 15px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111827); } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e7eb); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--raised, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #111827); font: 400 17px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--accent, #c2410c); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Surface sidebar with 44px rows; active row is raised, the open book carries an accent dot.
components.html: Audiokniha
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 248px; padding: 24px 16px; background: var(--surface, #f4f5f7); color: var(--ink, #111827); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; padding: 0 12px 18px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 600 15px/1 inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--line, #e5e7eb); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: var(--raised, #ffffff); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; margin: 0 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #c2410c); flex: none; }

components.name: Book Card
components.description: Generated typographic cover (hue 65-344, 45%, 30%) with title, meta and a 4px progress bar; lifts 3px on hover, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-book { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 180px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; color: var(--ink, #111827); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cover { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.3em; padding: 0.9em 0.85em; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; font-size: 18px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); transition: transform 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-cover::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14), transparent 45%); } .ds-cover-title { position: relative; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-cover-author { position: relative; opacity: 0.85; font-size: 0.8em; } .ds-book:hover .ds-cover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-book:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-book-name { margin-top: 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-book-meta { color: var(--ink-2, #4b5563); font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bar { display: block; height: 4px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--line, #e5e7eb); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar > span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent, #c2410c); border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Mini Player
components.description: Floating player below 1180px: raised bar with hairline, player-lift shadow and a 3px accent progress line.
components.html: Kapitola 312:04 / 31:50
components.css: .ds-mini { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 340px; padding: 8px 10px 8px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e7eb); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--raised, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #111827); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.08), 0 2px 6px rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.06); overflow: hidden; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mini-cover { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 6px; flex: none; } .ds-mini-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-mini-chapter { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; } .ds-mini-sub { color: var(--ink-2, #4b5563); font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mini-play { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #c2410c); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-mini-play:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #9a3412); } .ds-mini-play:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mini-progress { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--accent, #c2410c); }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Slate labels on a hairline baseline; the selected tab is ink with a 3px accent underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e7eb); } .ds-tab { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; margin-bottom: -1px; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #4b5563); font: 600 15px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #111827); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ink, #111827); border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #c2410c); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #c2410c); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Audiokniha looks and behaves like a good audiobook app, held to the bar of Audible and BookPlayer. It is the category standard done with full craft, not a distinctive world. The ground is neutral (white in light mode, near-black in dark), the type is the platform's own UI face, and the colour comes from two sources only: one warm orange accent that marks what is playing, progressing, selected or focused, and the generated cover of each book. Listening leads. The player stays reachable from every screen, and editing is one tap away inside a chapter.

The density is calm and generous. Body text is 17px, every control is at least 44px tall, and figures that change (durations, positions, speeds) are tabular so they do not jitter. Depth is almost absent. Surfaces separate by tone (bg, surface, raised) and 1px hairlines. The only lifted things belong to the player. Shapes are soft: 12px panels, 8px rows and covers, and pill-shaped buttons and chips.

Light and dark are equal citizens and follow `prefers-color-scheme`. Every token has a paired dark value, and both pass WCAG 2.2 AA.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral ground, one orange accent, colour covers as the only other hue.
System UI type on a short scale; weight (600 to 800) carries hierarchy more than size.
44px minimum touch target on every interactive element.
Flat, tonal surfaces; soft shadows reserved for the player.
One drawn icon set: 24px grid, 2px round strokes.
The player moves with the viewport: side panel, then floating mini player plus full-screen sheet.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Orange means state: playing, progressing, selected, focused, or the one primary action. It is never decoration, never a heading colour, and never a section background.

rules.name: The Cover Band Rule
rules.body: Generated covers stay inside hues 65° to 344° at 45% saturation and 30% lightness. Apart from the amber warning and red error status tokens, nothing else may use the accent's hue band.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every colour exists as a light and dark pair and swaps through `prefers-color-scheme`. A new colour without its dark twin is unfinished.

rules.name: The Steady Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates or lines up in a column (times, chapter numbers, speeds, progress) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: The interface uses only the system UI stack. Hierarchy is built with weight, size and tracking.

rules.name: The Only The Player Floats Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows, the library grid and page sections never cast shadows. A library cover answers hover with a 3px lift, not a shadow.

dos: Do keep every interactive element at 44px or more in its smallest dimension; make compact variants narrower, never shorter.
Do reserve the accent for play, progress, selection, focus and the single primary action on a screen.
Do give every new colour a dark-mode pair and check both against WCAG 2.2 AA.
Do use tabular figures for any number that updates or aligns.
Do draw new icons on the 24px grid with 2px round strokes, matching the existing set.
Do separate surfaces with tone (bg, surface, raised) and 1px hairlines before reaching for a shadow.
Do make hover-revealed controls permanently visible under `hover: none`, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, or use orange for headings, decoration or section fills.
Don't generate covers or illustrations inside the accent's red-orange band (345° to 65°). The amber warning and red error tokens are the only other hues allowed there, and only for status.
Don't put shadows on library cards, rows, tabs or page sections; only the player floats.
Don't add a web font or a second type family; use the system UI stack.
Don't use icon fonts, emoji or mixed icon sets.
Don't borrow the identity of the author's other project, Hits & Licks (black noir, blackletter, pixel art).
